public_kernel_scan.interpretation: The checked team-member listings show no public kernel run on or after the 2026-11-26 top submission. This does not establish that no public source exists elsewhere, or that older source was not reused.

inspected_kernel.finding: The notebook packages a prebuilt submission archive and generator source archives from Kaggle datasets; it does not rebuild the generators in this notebook. Its described invsqrt lineage uses ThemBones/Syed generators, and its DQI lineage is based on Syed v12 plus public contributions. The source contains no two-qubit invsqrt design.

decision: Do not treat this older packaging notebook as the current leader's method. The checked public kernel listings do not identify the method behind the 2026-11-26 score; continue with source-owned algorithm work and require a credible path to the score-equivalent DQI gate before a full verifier run.
